sources.excerpt: JHS Pedals 3 SERIES SCREAMER | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / JHS Pedals 3 SERIES SCREAMER 3 SERIES SCREAMER The JHS 3 Series Screamer is an affordable overdrive pedal based on the "Strong Mod" of the classic Tube Screamer , offering versatility and enhanced tonal balance. With its accessible controls and a toggle switch for clipping options, it provides a wide range of overdrive tones, from boosting to full-bore overdrive. It features increased clean headroom, versatile drive and tone controls, and an improved frequency response compared to a stock Tube Screamer , making it suitable for both beginners and professionals. This pedal seeks to improve on the original concept, providing a more balanced and usable take on the iconic mid-hump overdrive sound.
